long_biography.plain_text:
Juffali developed by pairing Saudi market knowledge with multinational partners, bringing vehicles, industrial equipment, power systems and technology into the kingdom. As chairman, Khaled Juffali provides strategic governance for the family enterprise. Its operating subsidiaries and partnerships remain group assets and should not be treated as his personal holdings one by one.

His more directly attributable venture is Khaled Juffali Company, which he founded as a private investment platform for creating and incubating growth businesses. The company takes both majority and significant minority positions across several sectors and regions. Juffali has also chaired the Saudi German Business Council, extending his commercial role through bilateral business cooperation.
